instruction:
Task: Shoot at enemy characters (e.g., the alien flamingo creature) and observe their combat behavior.
Expected Result: Enemies show damage effects or react when shot by the player. Enemies exhibit combat behaviors (e.g., moving towards/attacking the player). Player's status (e.g., health) can be affected by enemy actions.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: Enemies show damage effects or react when shot by the player. Enemies exhibit combat behaviors (e.g., moving towards/attacking the player). Player's status (e.g., health) can be affected by enemy actions.
